text: この　ポケモンは　ほんとに　げんきが　いいぞ！

structure.jp: ほんとに　げんきが　いいぞ！

patterns.name: 〜は〜が〜
patterns.span: ポケモンは　ほんとに　げんきが　いい
patterns.explanation: The は word is who we are talking about, and the が word is the part of it being described. ポケモンはげんきがいい = 'the Pokémon is full of energy' (word for word: as for the Pokémon, its energy is good).

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end makes the statement strong and confident, in a rough male way of talking. げんきがいいぞ = 'it's full of energy, I tell you!'
